video.title: Il ruolo dello sviluppatore nell'era dell'AI - GDG Brescia

abstract: At this GDG Brescia talk, Matteo Gazzurelli argues that AI has not made developers obsolete; it has shifted their job from typing code to specifying intent, constraining agents, and verifying results. It is a practical case for treating AI-assisted development as an engineering-governance problem, not just a productivity story.
mainTakeaway: The developer’s value is moving upward: the strongest engineers are the ones who can define clear specifications, design reliable agent loops, verify output, and keep responsibility for architecture and decisions instead of blindly trusting generated code.
